name: Z Press
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight out in front of you, and set a barbell at shoulder height on a rack or pick it up from there.
Hold the bar at your shoulders and brace your core.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower it back to your shoulders. Stay tall and do not lean back.
image_prompt_scene: Seated on the floor with the legs extended and the barbell at the shoulders.
